stem:
[Image: A graph of car production with time on the x-axis and total number of cars produced on the y-axis. Time goes from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. in one hour increments. Total number of cars produced goes from 0 to 400 in intervals of 50. A straight dotted line is drawn on the graph, going from the origin at 0 cars at 8 a.m., to the top right of the graph, at 4:00p.m. and 400 cars. A solid line is shown starting at the origin and going above the dotted line after 8:00a.m. and before 11:30 a.m. The solid line then goes below the dotted line from 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. It again goes above the dotted line from 1:30 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. and ends at 400 cars at 4:00 p.m. The straight line is steepest between 1 p.m and 2 p.m. and shows an increase of 150 cars during this hour.]

The solid line (——) on the graph shows car production by the NU Car Motor Company during a particular day.

The dotted line (-----) shows what the total number of cars produced would be if the rate of production were constant.

C. During which hour were the most cars produced?

figure_description: A line graph titled "Car Production". The horizontal axis is labeled "Time" with marked points for 8 am, 9 am, 10 am, 11 am, 12 noon, 1 pm, 2 pm, 3 pm, and 4 pm. The vertical axis is labeled "Total Number of Cars Produced" with grid marks from 0 to 400 in increments of 50. A dashed line segment runs directly from (8 am, 0) to (4 pm, 400). A solid line connects the points (8 am, 0), (9 am, 100), (10 am, 150), (1 pm, 200), (2 pm, 350), and (4 pm, 400).
